name: Greg Moser & Engineering Inc
old_description: Moser has been leading the competition since 1986 and continues to provide industry leading products. We pride ourselves in our ability to supply quality America-made products, at an affordable price
about:
Moser Engineering operates from a 100,000-square-foot facility in Portland, Indiana. The company was founded in 1986 by Greg Moser, who initially launched the business to support his own drag-racing habit at the Muncie strip. Today it remains family owned and operated.

The shop forges, heat-treats, and machines U.S. steel sourced from domestic mills to produce custom axles, complete rear-end assemblies, differential options, brake packages, and chassis/suspension components. Product lines include the Muscle Pak rear assemblies, circle-track/oval packages, and applications for GM, Ford, and Mopar platforms. Most custom orders ship in two business days or less.

Customers range from professional drag and circle-track teams to street-rod builders, Jeep and truck owners, and project-car restorers. The company's own race team campaigns two rigs and multiple cars, putting new components through on-track validation before release.

Moser Engineering cites three pillars for its approach: domestic manufacturing with full process control, rapid turnaround enabled by that control, and direct racing experience that informs product development. Staff includes current and former racers and builders, many with decades of tenure.
